evidenceSources.excerpt: Our Mesa Center provides food only.
Clothing Vouchers: Service is temporarily unavailable

Food and clothing items—free of charge—to all our guests.
When an application for Nutrition Assistance and Cash Assistance is received DES sends a notice to the household to complete the mandatory interview.
Cash Assistance (CA) benefits may only be provided for an assistance unit that resides in a needy family.
You will complete a membership application packet at your first visit, and update it each year to keep your membership current.
We give away clothing and hygiene items between 4:30 and 6:00

items.summary: Gilbert clothing supported. Homepage broadly promises clothing, but Centers explicitly limits Mesa to food; do not treat Mesa as clothing location. No known identities in sealed package.

fields.name: City Hope · Gilbert clothing
fields.address: 1120 S Gilbert Rd, Suite 101, Gilbert, AZ 85296

informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Bring a driver license or government-issued ID each time.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Visit without an appointment. Arrive at least 15 minutes before closing.
informationSections.access: This clothing location is in Gilbert. The provider’s Mesa location is listed as food only.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: One visit to each center per calendar month. Distribution may close early when 80 guests have been reached.

questions: Does Mesa offer clothing? https://www.cityhopeaz.org/ says clothing for all guests, but https://www.cityhopeaz.org/centers says Mesa provides food only. Gilbert remains the supported nearby clothing location.

items.summary: Direct adult closet supported independently of vouchers. Get Help service list says vouchers temporarily unavailable; Clothe says appointment only. Both accounts preserved. The reviewed pages do not state clothing costs, required documents or repeat limits; ask the front desk. No closure inferred.

fields.name: Paz de Cristo · Clothing Closet
fields.description: Adult everyday and interview clothing in Mesa.
fields.hours: Clothing Closet: Monday and Friday, 1–2pm. Showers: Wednesday, 9am–1pm.

informationSections.programsAndServices: Ask for everyday or interview clothes. Shower guests also receive fresh clothing and hygiene items.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: The closet serves adults and has no children’s clothing.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Visit the campus during closet hours. Ask staff for the sizes and items you need.
informationSections.access: Clothing is distributed at the Mesa campus.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: Available sizes and seasonal items depend on donations. Ask about any cost or required documents. Call before seeking a Deseret Industries voucher; published availability is unclear.

questions: Are Deseret Industries vouchers currently available? https://pazdecristo.org/what-we-do/get-help-original/ lists them as temporarily unavailable, while its overview and https://pazdecristo.org/what-we-do/clothe/ say appointment only. Keep the supported adult closet entry while this is checked.
What documents or repeat-visit limits apply, and is clothing free? The reviewed clothing pages do not state these rules.

items.summary: The AZAFAP Jose’s Closet membership section lists first-visit documents and annual renewal, but does not say whether recipients need an appointment or whether informal kinship families without placement/guardianship papers qualify. Its no-appointment wording concerns donors. Call Jose’s Closet about those two recipient questions.

fields.name: Jose’s Closet
fields.description: Free children’s clothing for foster, kinship and adoptive households in Mesa.
fields.address: 6515 E Main St, Suite 120, Mesa, AZ 85205

informationSections.programsAndServices: Monthly shopping provides a week of clothing and seasonal essentials per child.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: For foster, kinship and adoptive families, and youth in extended foster care. Membership includes household children up to age 21.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Bring caregiver photo ID; placement or guardianship documents; adoption papers if applicable; and birth certificates for biological children. Complete membership paperwork at the first visit and renew yearly. Call or email info@josescloset.org about a first visit.
informationSections.access: The boutique is in Mesa and supports Arizona families.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: Clothing is free. First-visit appointment requirements are not stated.

questions: Is an appointment needed for the first shopping visit? https://www.azafap.org/joses-closet/ explains membership documents, but its no-appointment statement concerns donation drop-off.
Can kinship caregivers without placement or guardianship papers receive help? The membership section asks for those records.
